title: Workplace and Community Organisation Responses
description: This module equips workplaces, clubs, and community organisations to recognise DFV, support affected members, and create safe organisational cultures. It focuses on policies, safe responses, and building supportive environments.
outcomes: Recognise DFV indicators within workplaces and community organisations
Respond safely and appropriately to disclosures or concerns
Develop policies and practices that promote safety and support
